scripts.dev: rimraf frontend/.next && concurrently -r "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "BACKEND_PORT=3001 npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
